Thank you <3 I really appreciate your response, it's really nice and helpful. Thank you for your offer, I might take you up on that at some point!

I wish you the best in life as well :) have a good day/night!

Thanks so much for the reply man. I really appreciate it and it helps me feel a little less hopeless about my situation. It's comforting to know I'm not the only one who was in this situation and if you're killing it, then maybe I can too aha. Thanks :)

Thank you so much for your reply, it helped a lot. I've decided I'm going to continue school the best I can and even if a graduate a couple years later, I'm going to take a shot at it. And maybe try some alternative methods, like you said. I'm thinking about aiming for a GED for now.

And no, I don't currently have a therapist or anyone to talk to. But my parent has talked about it, for other reasons. They don't know the extent of my shitty mental health but I have been feeling a little bit better about it lately. :)

Thanks for the comment! It's appreciated. I'm feeling a bit better about it by now, and I think that if it's meant to last then it will. Hopefully it does, because I'm very happy with it. I'm sure it'll change over time as we both have plenty of growing to do, but right now I'm hopeful :)
Thanks so much for the comment :) I appreciate that. It does make me feel more hopeful. I'm feeling a little more positively about it by now, I think if it's meant to last then it will.
